name: @jarei/openwhale-boros

scripts.build:plugin: pnpm build && esbuild src/plugin.ts --bundle --format=esm --platform=node --target=es2022 --external:@openwhaleorg/core --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --outfile=dist/boros.plugin.mjs
